metas.name: Drishyam 3
metas.description: To protect his family and their dark secret, Georgekutty faces an organized new threat. As walls close in and cracks widen, how much more is he willing to sacrifice?

metas.name: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
metas.description: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

metas.name: Mard Ko Dard Nahin Hota
metas.description: It is a story of a young boy Surya who has a rare condition of Congenital Insensitivity to pain meaning he can not feel pain, and he sets out to learn martial arts and hunt down muggers.

metas.name: Drishyam 2
metas.description: 7 years after the case related to Vijay Salgaonkar and his family was closed, a series of unexpected events bring truth to light that threatens to change everything for the Salgaonkars. Can Vijay save his family this time?

metas.name: Drishyam
metas.description: When his family stares down the barrel of criminal charges, a commoner channels his street smarts and knowledge of action films to tie the long arm of the law into an investigative Gordian knot.

metas.name: Chachi 420
metas.description: Desperation to be with his only child forces a divorced man to take the guise of the child's nanny. Situations get really messy when the child's grandfather (the man's ex-father-in-law) falls in love with his disguised ex-son-in-law.

metas.name: Nude
metas.description: NUDE explores perceptions of nudity in art by chronicling the creative process of photographer David Bellemere as he's commissioned by NU Muses founder Steve Shaw to shoot a fine art calendar of nude photographs.

metas.name: Panipat
metas.description: The Great Betrayal is a War Epic set in 1761, when Sadashiv Rao Bhau Peshwa led the Maratha army to the north of India to repel the invading forces of Ahmad Shah Abdali, the King of Afghanistan.

metas.name: 365 dni
metas.description: Massimo is a member of the Sicilian Mafia family and Laura is a sales director. She does not expect that on a trip to Sicily trying to save her relationship, Massimo will kidnap her and give her 365 days to fall in love with him.

metas.name: How to Have Sex
metas.description: Three British teenage girls go on a rites-of-passage holiday - drinking, clubbing and hooking up, in what should be the best summer of their lives.

metas.name: Pogaru
metas.description: Shiva, a local Ruffian is unstoppable in his path as he had garnered the support and affection of the general public by fighting against the injustice that comes their way.

metas.name: Sardar 2
metas.description: Follows spy Sardar's origin story in flashback while his son Inspector Vijay confronts a villain known as Black Dagger in the present day.

metas.name: Strange Days
metas.description: In the last days of 1999, ex-cop turned street hustler Lenny Nero receives a disc which contains the memories of the murder of a prostitute. With the help of bodyguard Mace, he starts to investigate and is pulled deeper and deeper in a whirl of murder, blackmail and intrigue.

metas.name: Love You Ram
metas.description: Imagine the heartbreak when someone you loved from childhood turns out to be a crook. Will Divya be old-fashioned and be with Ram or will she leave him?

metas.name: Mahendragiri Varahi
metas.description: Siddharth, an atheist skeptical of the supernatural, investigates a series of mysterious deaths in Mahendragiri attributed to the goddess Vaaraahi.

metas.name: Backrooms
metas.description: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.

metas.name: Anweshippin Kandethum
metas.description: Revolves around two major crimes that shook kerala and the subsequent inquiry into the cases by sop.

metas.name: Mandaadi
metas.description: A fishing captain applies his maritime knowledge in a traditional boat race along Tamil Nadu's coast during a festival, leading a six-person team against other crews.

metas.name: Ghostbusters
metas.description: After losing their university jobs, three parapsychologists start a ghost-catching business in New York City and uncover a supernatural threat that could destroy the world.

metas.name: Love Per Square Foot
metas.description: Individually, Sanjay and Karina don't earn enough to be able to buy a home, so they enter into a marriage of convenience.

metas.name: Sardar
metas.description: An espionage agent who is branded a traitor returns from exile to take down a dubious water project and safeguard the country.

metas.name: Natsamrat
metas.description: Harindra Pathak is the protagonist who goes on to realize that his popularity & importance stay valid & relevant only till he is onstage. Let down by circumstances & his own blood, Harindra eventually retires to a life of complete obscurity and alienation.  It is a remake of 2016 Marathi film of the same name starring Nana Patekar, which is based on a Marathi play by Kusumagraj (V. V. Shirwadkar).

metas.name: Shut In
metas.description: A widowed child psychologist lives an isolated existence in rural New England. Caught in a deadly winter storm, she must find a way to rescue a young boy before he disappears forever.

metas.name: Scream 7
metas.description: Sidney fights to protect her daughter when Ghostface stalks their quiet Indiana town, forcing a survivor's family to confront old trauma, media spectacle, and a killer who weaponizes deep-fakes.

metas.name: Maa Inti Bangaram
metas.description: Through both her moments of fear and bravery, a woman discovers that embracing her vulnerabilities is as vital to her inner strength as facing challenges head-on.

metas.name: Dookudu
metas.description: Ajay, (Mahesh Babu) an undercover cop, is assigned to catch a dangerous mafia don with whom he has a personal score to settle.

metas.name: Romanchakam
metas.description: An entrepreneur hoping to make money off romance ends up falling in love. But when she blocks him on social media, he tries to reignite their spark.

metas.name: Halloween
metas.description: Laurie Strode comes to her final confrontation with Michael Myers, the masked figure who has haunted her since she narrowly escaped his killing spree on Halloween night four decades ago.

metas.name: Kismat Konnection
metas.description: A luckless architect discovers a social activist to be his lucky charm. Unfortunately, she's protecting the community center he's aiming to win a contract to tear down.

metas.name: Vishwanath & Sons
metas.description: A celebrated Olympian shooter travels to America looking for a donor to help his sick child — but unexpected romance complicates his search.

metas.name: The Inventor: Out for Blood in Silicon Valley
metas.description: With a magical new invention that promised to revolutionize blood testing, Elizabeth Holmes became the world’s youngest self-made billionaire, heralded as the next Steve Jobs. Then, overnight, her 10-billion-dollar company dissolved. The rise and fall of Theranos is a window into the psychology of fraud.

metas.name: Devara: Part 1
metas.description: A mighty sea warrior takes a violent stand against the criminal deeds of his village. Years later, his mild-mannered son walks a path of his own.

metas.name: Blade Runner
metas.description: In the smog-choked dystopian Los Angeles of 2019, blade runner Rick Deckard is called out of retirement to terminate a quartet of replicants who have escaped to Earth seeking their creator for a way to extend their short life spans.

metas.name: Casper
metas.description: Casper is a kind young ghost who peacefully haunts a mansion in Maine. When specialist James Harvey arrives to communicate with Casper and his fellow spirits, he brings along his teenage daughter, Kat. Casper quickly falls in love with Kat, but their budding relationship is complicated not only by his transparent state, but also by his troublemaking apparition uncles and their mischievous antics.

metas.name: Welcome
metas.description: A man falls in love with a beautiful woman, but later discovers that her brothers are gangsters.

metas.name: The Life of Chuck
metas.description: In this extraordinary story of an ordinary man, Charles 'Chuck' Krantz experiences the wonder of love, the heartbreak of loss, and the multitudes contained in all of us.

metas.name: Interstellar
metas.description: In a dystopian future where Earth has become near-uninhabitable, a team of astronauts embark on a mission to find a new home for humanity.

metas.name: Operation Java
metas.description: The story revolves around a group of officers and a series of mysteries, events and cases reported before them in the Cyber Cell. It is also about how they plan and execute their operations.

metas.name: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
metas.description: An alien is left behind on Earth and saved by the 10-year-old Elliott who decides to keep him hidden in his home. While a task force hunts for the extra-terrestrial, Elliott, his brother, and his little sister Gertie form an emotional bond with their new friend, and try to help him find his way home.

metas.name: I Think I Love My Wife
metas.description: A married man who daydreams about being with other women finds his will and morals tested after he's visited by the ex-mistress of his old friend.

metas.name: Shahid
metas.description: A story based on real-life human-rights and criminal lawyer, Shahid Azmi, who was slain while defending the wrongly accused by the law in terrorist activities.

metas.name: The Purge: Election Year
metas.description: Two years after choosing not to kill the man who killed his son, former police sergeant Leo Barnes has become head of security for Senator Charlene Roan, the front runner in the next Presidential election due to her vow to eliminate the Purge. On the night of what should be the final Purge, a betrayal from within the government forces Barnes and Roan out onto the street where they must fight to survive the night.

metas.name: Maya Bazaar
metas.description: Balarama promises Subhadra to get his daughter married to her son. But when the Pandavas loses their kingdom to the Kaurava's, Balarama breaks his promise.

metas.name: Ohh My Dog
metas.description: A young child forms an unexpected bond with a stray dog, embarking on an adventure that reveals the profound ways animals and humans can heal each other's hearts.

metas.name: I Saw the TV Glow
metas.description: In late-90s suburbia, a lonely teenager meets a girl at school who introduces him to a mysterious late-night T.V. show — a vision of a supernatural world pulsing beneath their own. As time goes on, however, questions begin to arise about why the show sometimes seems more real than their own lives. In the pale glow of the television, their view of reality begins to crack.

metas.name: Crew
metas.description: Follows three hard-working women as their destinies lead to some unwarranted situations and they end up caught in a web of lies.

metas.name: Pushpa: The Rule - Part 2
metas.description: As his smuggling empire grows, a brazen Pushpa longs for power and respect on his vengeful journey, while facing old rivals and new.

metas.name: Jana Nayagan
metas.description: A clash of ideologies. One stands for the people, the other feeds on control. Their paths collided once before. Years later, a child’s silent fear ignites the past, drawing a former police officer into a battle far bigger than personal revenge.

metas.name: Pokkiri
metas.description: Thamizh is a killer for hire with no ties and who will do any dirty job for money. He has a girlfriend who loves him but also detests his violent nature. But is Thamizh really what he purports to be?

metas.name: undertone
metas.description: The host of a popular paranormal podcast becomes haunted by terrifying recordings mysteriously sent her way.
